Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

Both Zimbabwe imported intervals include Southern Rhodesia and are labelled kind region/dateBasis map_coverage. Independence is18April1980, not1920or1960. The existing great-zimbabwe card remains separate; no medievalstate-to-modernrepublic continuity of government is invented. Imported borders/generatedrecords/attribution are unchanged; Asia assignment untouched.

The1952USmemorandum was read directly in full main text. Only historical administration and1923change are used; its racialized language and assessments of political maturity are not adopted. The UN authority note was read in full indexed text; directopening403. It supplies1953federation andDecember1963dissolution. This catalogue is not claimed to document every constitutional event. NationalArchives CabinetPapers directlink failed and was not used.

Parliament history was read in full indexed text and maintext by directfind. Political-exclusion and institutional milestones are used. Its promotional account of currentdemocracy and the misleading1923firstlegislature label are not adopted as comprehensive history. The1980independence date and USnonrecognition of1965UDI were read directly in OfficeoftheHistorian, crosschecked SADC. The1980–2013phase identifies statehood rather than implying peacefuloruninterrupted democratic practice; this card is not an exhaustive account of postindependence violence, economiccrises or landreform.2017resignation follows parliamentaryproceedings in thissource, not a claim that parliament was the sole cause.

Mukwende2025Metessay was read in full main text and is distinct from the2001Metessay already used by great-zimbabwe. Its cotton-spinning discs, charredsorghum, metalworking remnants and occupationchronology are used with archaeological limits. No named trench, house, exactgarment or recipe absentfromsource is invented. Thefifth-century metallurgy mentioned in theessay is not assigned to thelater capital’s founding. Populationestimates, cattledraftuse and unsupported totaldominance are omitted. Chronology extendsinto17thcentury rather than repeatingcategorical1450abandonment.

Metheadrest2001.759.2 was read directly: wood, late19th–mid20thcentury, Zimbabwe, easternShonastyle, figureeightbase/circularandangularmotifs. It is a museumcollection object, not an excavated GreatZimbabwehouseholdfind. Competing interpretations of motifs remain open. Thecatalogue’s gendergeneralizations and obsoletepresenttenseclaimsofhowfewpeopleuseheadrests are not projected onto all families today. No spiritualbelief is asserted as a physical fact.

proposedOverrides.summary: Zimbabwe became independent on 18 April 1980. These map records also cover earlier Southern Rhodesia, including company administration, colonial minority rule and the disputed Rhodesian declaration of 1965. Their starting years, 1920 and 1960, are map coverage dates rather than the republic’s founding.

sharedAssociations.basis: Imported names and positions identify Southern Rhodesia and later independent Zimbabwe. Both map intervals include colonial years and use a shared regional history rather than backdating the modern republic.
